text: The teeth whitening by cool light gave me amazing result in just 1 hour. My teeth became noticeably brighter. I was impressed with professional service and the friendliness of all personnel. Hope to come back again when I have a chance. Thank you.

Prices were inexpensive and office seemed hygienic.  I think my teeth were cleaned for maybe 5-8 minutes.  Process seemed quite rushed and equipment did not seem as modern as I would expect.  I would not recommend for someone who wants a thorough job, but it seems appropriate for the price.
Great Clinic . I have been coming here for the last 12 years...great service and expo. I recommend Dr. Sun...He is the best.

Made an appointment here a week ago and got a confirmation through email. When we got to the clinic, they decided to cancel the appointment cause the dentist wasn't around. I don't think I got an apology for that and somehow they managed to blame me for not having a phone number even though we exchanged several emails about it.

It was definitely unprofessional and would not want to book another appointment here again.

I saw a teeth whitening offer and decided to stop by. I was able to get my teeth cleaned and whitened right away. Really pleased with the professionalism of the staff and dentist. Nice  job and the price was excellent.

Excellent dental clinic, clean, the doctor is very responsible and has high medical ethics. The staff are attentive and meticulous in their service. Conveniently located. Five-star rating.

text: The doctor here is gentle, the prices are good and not expensive, and the equipment is clean.
I had a root canal treatment here. The dentist did a great job; it wasn't very painful and they were very polite.

I had full mouth dental implants done, and the results are excellent and beautiful. The procedure itself was painless. Several teeth had bone grafts included, which the doctor incorporated into the price with no extra charges. It's unbelievable that Thonglor has such affordable dental implants with such great service! The clinic is clean, the equipment is modern, and the staff are very attentive and helpful.

This is my second time having root canal treatment here.
The doctor and all the staff provided excellent service. There was no pain during the procedure at all. The results afterwards are great, beautiful and look like natural teeth. And the price is reasonable for the Thonglor area.
P.S. The doctor extracted the tooth for free and also performed bone grafting for free. Thank you so much!
I've been getting my dental work done by Dr. Nueng Patthama for a long time now and I really like her. Please stay here for a long time! (She's beautiful and speaks so nicely too!)

I had 6 ceramic crowns made at this clinic. The dentist was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. The price was reasonable, and the quality of the crowns is excellent. They look beautiful and natural. I didn't have to keep my mouth open for long, and I got them fitted very quickly!
This clinic provides excellent service. The doctor is lovely, and the staff are also very nice.
The doctor here has a very gentle hand. It's very convenient to get to, right next to BTS Thonglor.
I had my teeth cleaned (tartar removed). The dentist was very gentle. I was very impressed. I highly recommend him/her.

I had dental implants here. The doctor was very kind and provided excellent service. He was very gentle. All the staff were very helpful and provided great care.
I had a follow-up check-up two years after the procedure. The work is excellent and there are no problems.
If you're considering dental implants, do your research on this clinic thoroughly.

I came here for dental implant treatment. It was very good. The doctor has a very gentle hand. The price is not as expensive as I thought. The staff are very attentive. The clinic is near BTS Thonglor, very convenient to travel.
